mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 67 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. The full moon is out tonight, and while the ISS passes overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 57 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Planning Department has issued a scam alert warning residents about fake emails requesting wire transfers for permit fees; please remember that the city only accepts checks delivered to the administration building. Also, public works crews are preparing for the start of the fall leaf collection season beginning October 5.
Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing Co. for trivia. Tomorrow, the town comes alive with Verona Fall Fest and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
Regarding local safety, on September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, second offence, after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for an exciting remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report at this time.
